notes: Harden Stage 2 and design the next vertical slice (daemon + worktrees + L0). Independent inspect/review tasks run in parallel. Design and integrate wait on those reviews. Real Pi workers only (pi --print --mode json). Fake provider is not allowed for this plan. Do not modify Pi core. If Pi is unavailable, fail — do not silently switch providers.

tasks.title: Audit done vs INIT_short
tasks.objective: Compare INIT_short and docs/roadmap.md with the current tree. List what Stage 0/1/2 already ship, what Stage 3 only stubs, and the smallest next slice that does not rebuild bootstrap.
constraints: Do not treat fake-provider Stage 2 reports as semantic reviews.
tasks.expectedOutput: Ordered gap list: done / partial / missing. Recommend one vertical slice only.

tasks.title: Inspect orchestrator run loop
tasks.objective: Read the orchestrator, scheduler, worker-manager, and CLI. Determine what must be extracted so `pi-many-agents run <plan.json>` works without a Pi session, and what the thin /many extension should call instead of running in-process.
tasks.expectedOutput: Concrete extraction points, public CLI flags, abort/cleanup behavior on session_shutdown.

tasks.title: Inspect providers and no-paid-fallback
tasks.objective: Review AgentProvider implementations and catalog. Confirm available() is honest, Pi profiles still use pi --print --mode json, and there is no silent switch from fake/local/unavailable to a paid cloud model.
constraints: Do not invent CLI flags or provider APIs.
If a provider is unavailable, report that; do not route to paid.
tasks.expectedOutput: Capability matrix, unavailable providers, fallback risks, required tests.

tasks.title: Find missing tests for next slice
tasks.objective: Read existing tests. Name missing coverage for daemon abort/cleanup, worktree single-writer, L0 skipped when unavailable, no paid fallback, and /many compact reports after thrown runs.

tasks.title: Confirm task packet isolation
tasks.objective: Review renderTaskPacket and /many. Confirm workers never receive parent conversation state. List any field that would leak session history if added carelessly.

tasks.title: Design git worktrees and single-writer
tasks.objective: Propose the minimal worktree layout worktrees/<taskId> for type=code only, path-prefix locks, and AgentReport.changes relative to the worktree. Orchestrator must not auto-merge. Do not implement in this task.
constraints: Coding workers must not share a dirty tree.
Non-code tasks stay in the main workspace read-only unless specified.
tasks.expectedOutput: API sketch, lock rules, cleanup, test cases, ADR outline for 0008-worktrees.

tasks.title: Design daemon + store
tasks.objective: Propose how the run loop leaves the Pi process: CLI daemon or one-shot runner, how /many attaches, how session_shutdown aborts, and a Store interface (SQLite preferred, JSONL acceptable with justification). Do not implement in this task.
constraints: No distributed system. Local subprocesses are enough.
Do not require paid APIs for the happy path.
tasks.expectedOutput: Process model, attach protocol, persistence schema, ADR outline for 0007-daemon.

tasks.title: Design local L0 advisor
tasks.objective: Propose using an available local provider (Ollama gemma4 if available()) only for classify, report compression, near-dup fingerprint assist, and escalate recommendation. L0 must not spawn processes or edit files. If unavailable, skip and log.
constraints: Orchestrator remains authoritative; L0 only advises.
tasks.expectedOutput: L0 call sites, skip behavior, tests when Ollama is down.

tasks.title: Integrate next-slice change list
tasks.objective: Read the other task reports and produce one ordered implementation list for the primary agent: files to touch, tests to add, ADRs to write, commands to run (test, lint, typecheck, demo). Do not edit Pi core. Do not start Codex/Grok/Gemini standalone adapters.
tasks.expectedOutput: Prioritized change list, stop condition, and three follow-up /many tasks.
